lyrics.ja: 信じたい未来を今この手 掴みとるから
lyrics.romaji: Shinjitai Mirai wo Ima Kono Te Tsukamitoru kara
lyrics.en: Because I'll seize the future I want to believe in with these hands now
lyrics.zh: 因為我要用這雙手，抓住想相信的未來

lyrics.ja: 諦める事は まだ早いの
lyrics.romaji: Akirameru Koto ha Mada Hayai no
lyrics.en: It's still too early to give up
lyrics.zh: 放棄還太早了

lyrics.ja: 綺麗になる burning heart
lyrics.romaji: Kirei ni Naru Burning Heart
lyrics.en: My burning heart becomes beautiful
lyrics.zh: 變得美麗的 burning heart

lyrics.ja: もっと もっと輝けるわ butterfly
lyrics.romaji: Motto Motto Kagayakeru wa Butterfly
lyrics.en: I can shine more, more—butterfly
lyrics.zh: 能更加更加閃耀喔 butterfly

lyrics.ja: ネイルに新しいグロスで 退屈な日々
lyrics.romaji: Neiru ni Atarashii Gurosu de Taikutsu na Hibi
lyrics.en: With new gloss on my nails, these boring days
lyrics.zh: 用新光澤點綴指甲，無聊的日子

lyrics.ja: 変えたいの 君の為 自分の為に
lyrics.romaji: Kaetai no Kimi no Tame Jibun no Tame ni
lyrics.en: I want to change them—for you, for myself
lyrics.zh: 想要改變，為了你，也為了我自己

lyrics.ja: 届くかは自分次第なら やってみせるわ
lyrics.romaji: Todoku ka ha Jibun Shidai Nara Yatte Miseru wa
lyrics.en: If whether it reaches is up to me, then I'll make it happen
lyrics.zh: 如果能否傳達取決於自己，那我就做給你看

lyrics.ja: 浮いたり 沈んだり 繰り返しても
lyrics.romaji: Uitari Shizundari Kurikaeshite mo
lyrics.en: Even if I keep floating and sinking
lyrics.zh: 即使不斷浮浮沉沉

lyrics.ja: 君は私の『すべて』ではない
lyrics.romaji: Kimi ha Watashi no 『Subete』 de ha Nai
lyrics.en: You are not my "everything"
lyrics.zh: 你並不是我的『全部』

lyrics.ja: だけど いないと『すべて』が
lyrics.romaji: Dakedo Inai to 『Subete』 ga
lyrics.en: But without you, "everything"
lyrics.zh: 但若沒有你，『一切』

lyrics.ja: ダメになる だから
lyrics.romaji: Dame ni Naru Dakara
lyrics.en: Falls apart, so
lyrics.zh: 都會變得不行，所以

lyrics.ja: 何かが変わったと 早く気付かせたい
lyrics.romaji: Nanika ga Kawatta to Hayaku Kizukasetai
lyrics.en: I want to make you quickly notice that something has changed
lyrics.zh: 想讓你快點察覺，有些事情已經改變了

lyrics.ja: 信じたい未来を今この手 掴みとるから
lyrics.romaji: Shinjitai Mirai wo Ima Kono Te Tsukamitoru kara
lyrics.en: Because I'll seize the future I want to believe in with these hands now
lyrics.zh: 因為我要用這雙手，抓住想相信的未來

lyrics.ja: 諦める事は まだ早いの
lyrics.romaji: Akirameru Koto ha Mada Hayai no
lyrics.en: It's still too early to give up
lyrics.zh: 放棄還太早了

lyrics.ja: 綺麗になる burning heart
lyrics.romaji: Kirei ni Naru Burning Heart
lyrics.en: My burning heart becomes beautiful
lyrics.zh: 變得美麗的 burning heart

lyrics.ja: もっと もっと輝けるわ butterfly
lyrics.romaji: Motto Motto Kagayakeru wa Butterfly
lyrics.en: I can shine more, more—butterfly
lyrics.zh: 能更加更加閃耀喔 butterfly

lyrics.ja: バスタイム泡風船に 君の笑顔映し
lyrics.romaji: Basu Taimu Awa Fuusen ni Kimi no Egao Utsushi
lyrics.en: In bath time bubbles, I project your smile
lyrics.zh: 泡澡時光，在泡泡氣球上映出你的笑容

lyrics.ja: 問いかける 今君はどうしてるの?
lyrics.romaji: Toikakeru Ima Kimi ha Doushiteru no?
lyrics.en: I ask—what are you doing right now?
lyrics.zh: 輕聲問著，你現在在做什麼呢？

lyrics.ja: 奇跡は何度でも 起きるの そうよ
lyrics.romaji: Kiseki ha Nando demo Okiru no Sou yo
lyrics.en: Miracles can happen again and again—yes, they can
lyrics.zh: 奇蹟無論幾次都會發生，是啊

lyrics.ja: 季節が何度もこうして 巡って来るように
lyrics.romaji: Kisetsu ga Nando mo Koushite Megutte Kuru You ni
lyrics.en: Just as the seasons come around again and again like this
lyrics.zh: 就像季節一次又一次這樣循環到來

lyrics.ja: 素敵な事でしょ? 信じてみたいから
lyrics.romaji: Suteki na Koto Desho? Shinjite Mitai kara
lyrics.en: Isn't it wonderful? Because I want to try believing
lyrics.zh: 很棒對吧？因為我想試著相信

lyrics.ja: 小さな思い出を手繰り寄せ 抱きしめ眠る
lyrics.romaji: Chiisana Omoide wo Taguriyose Dakishime Nemuru
lyrics.en: I pull small memories close, hold them, and sleep
lyrics.zh: 將小小的回憶拉到身邊，擁抱著入睡

lyrics.ja: 目覚めた時 気付くこの想い
lyrics.romaji: Mezameta Toki Kizuku Kono Omoi
lyrics.en: When I wake, I realize these feelings
lyrics.zh: 醒來時察覺的這份心意

lyrics.ja: 君以外 見えない
lyrics.romaji: Kimi Igai Mienai
lyrics.en: I can see no one but you
lyrics.zh: 除了你，誰也看不見

lyrics.ja: もっと もっと輝かせて butterfly
lyrics.romaji: Motto Motto Kagayakasete Butterfly
lyrics.en: Make me shine more, more—butterfly
lyrics.zh: 讓我更加更加閃耀吧 butterfly
